newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo builds JV paper mill in China.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo builds JV paper mill in China.

text.p: South Korea's Daewoo Corp, a unit of Daewoo Group, said on Friday it will build a joint venture paper plant at Mudanjiang City in Heilongjiang Province, China.
Daewoo said in a statement that a total investment of $50 million would be made in the plant, to be named Daewoo Paper Co Ltd.
It said Daewoo would hold a 55 percent stake in the plant, followed by China's Mudanjiang Paper Mill with 40 percent and South Korea's Shinmoorim Paper Manufacturing Co Ltd, five percent.
The plant was expected to start operations from March 1999, and produce 40,000 tonnes of art paper a year. Annual sales was seen reaching $40 million, it said.
To build the plant, Daewoo would export $30 million worth plant materials to China, it added.
